title: Implement Merkle Hash Functions for All Entities
description: Define hash* function for every entity. Use hashes of the collections for the children. Build a merkle hash tree. Hence hashKit calls hashDesign that calls hashPiece, etc. Extend a test Kit/Hash. Implement it for every programming language. They all MUST return the same hash.
summary: Fixed scene pieces showing red in all states by removing the hardcoded SCENE_COMPOSE_COLOR (#ff344f brand red) as the base mesh color. ScenePieceModel now uses a neutral gray (--muted-foreground) for default pieces and the appropriate status color (red/green/yellow) for diffed pieces. ScenePiece box fallback now uses meshColor (gray for default, status color for diffed, accent for selected/hovered) matching the SceneConnection pattern. Removed the unused SCENE_COMPOSE_COLOR constant.
